'''Duala Aidu''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]], a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Biography==
In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] ventured to Dathomir on business with the Singing Mountain Clan and as he approach the clan's stronghold, he was spotted by Aidu and the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Magash Drashi]], and the pair escorted him to their [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]], [[Augwynne Djo]]. Pavan subsequently sought the aid of the witches to allow him to access the secrets of [[SD41263.I|the holocron]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ramage]], which would only activate after being provided with a large quantity of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive being, and Aidu, Djo, Drashi and Pavan all donated blood to allow the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] open the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].
